name: Batch Register Images
description: Perform batch registration of multiple images to a single reference image. Automatically processes all medical image files in a directory and registers them to the fixed reference. Supports rigid, aff
detailed_description: Perform batch registration of multiple images to a single reference image. Automatically processes all medical image files in a directory and registers them to the fixed reference. Supports rigid, affine, or deformable registration for all images.
when_to_use: When you need batch register images analysis

parameters.fixed_image_path: [Required] Path to the reference (fixed) image file (str)
parameters.moving_images_dir: [Required] Directory path containing multiple images to register (supports .nii, .nii.gz, .nrrd, .mha, .mhd formats) (str)
parameters.output_dir: [Required] Directory path to save registration results for all images (str)
parameters.transform_type: [Optional] Type of registration to perform: 'rigid', 'affine', or 'deformable' (default: rigid)
parameters.metric: [Optional] Similarity metric for registration: 'mutual_information', 'mean_squares', 'correlation', or 'normalized_correlation' (default: mutual_information)
parameters.preprocess: [Optional] Whether to preprocess images (denoising and normalization) (default: True)
parameters.create_visualizations: [Optional] Whether to create visualization plots for each registration (default: True)
parameters.learning_rate: [Optional] Learning rate for gradient descent optimizer (default: 0.01)
